text: Try the save control once and watch the loaded counter.
objective_quote: Explore the item and save systems: try the save control, load the slot, and compare the counter before and after, across a scene reset, reporting what changed and what did not, with the exact reading you saw and the turn it came from, in the order you observed it.
continue_if: the loaded counter still changes after the save
replan_if: the loaded counter stays wrong after a save
